meta.source: Meridian's product UI and the Q3 2026 board deck (projects/product-ui, projects/q3-review)

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, table rules, dividers.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles and body text, on paper and surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions, on paper and surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Footers, axis labels and timestamps, on paper and surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary actions, links and the one highlighted series, on paper and surface.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, chips and the tint behind brand text.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Results on or above target, on paper and surface.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Misses and destructive actions, on paper and surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Risks to watch and pending states, on paper and surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The accent other surfaces pick up; an alias of brand.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Inter Tight, semibold, tracked in: titles only.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: Every content slide's title, at the top margin; a full sentence that states the point.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The one number a slide or card is about.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Expansion in Scale accounts did most of the work.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a slide title; ink-muted, at most three lines.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section and topic above a title, in capitals, in brand.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ending ARR, up from $48.6M in Q2.
styles.usage: Captions, table text and footers; the smallest size on a slide.

tokens.name: space-card-gap
tokens.usage: Between a number and its caption inside a card.

tokens.name: space-card-x
tokens.usage: A card's side padding (28px top and bottom).

tokens.name: space-margin
tokens.usage: The slide margin; 160px at the bottom where a footer sits.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers; cards stay flat with a hairline.
